newsitem.title: MOROCCO: EU team starts N.Africa trip before Malta meeting.
newsitem.headline: EU team starts N.Africa trip before Malta meeting.

text.p: European Union officials start a working visit to south Mediterranean countries on Monday ahead of a meeting of 27 foreign ministers in Malta next month, officials said.
Dutch Foreign Minister Hans van Mierlo, who is also European Union council of ministers' chairman, was due in Morocco later on Monday for talks with Prime Minister Abdellatif Filali.
"Mr van Mierlo will discuss general European questions and the Euro-Mediterranean conference being held in Malta next April 15 and 16...and also bilateral matters," a Dutch embassy statement said.
Morocco has signed an association agreement with the EU for a free trade zone, excluding agriculture, by the year 2010, and Algeria -- van Mierlo's next stop -- is negotiating an accord.
Van Mierlo, who is to meet King Hassan late on Monday, is accompanied by European Commission vice-president Manuel Marin.
The delegation is due to visit Algeria on Tuesday, then head to Malta, Egypt and Turkey, officials said. 311220 GMT mar 97
